method.visual_review: Reviewed contact sheets of all unique QX image assets and QT page images, then opened representative assets and source-page images at high resolution. Checked that figure content corresponds to the labeled question and whether a question-level attachment contains unrelated neighboring questions.
method.source_comparison: Compared stored page images with the corresponding official PDF page layout. The page images visibly contain the printed page number, multiple question headings, body text and alternatives; this distinguishes them from individual figure crops.
limitations: This is an asset-scope and visual correspondence audit, not a complete transcription/OCR audit of all 144 questions or answer keys.
The contact-sheet review can identify wrong-question, page-level and obvious legibility issues; it does not certify every small label at full reading size.
method.tooling_note: Docling was not available as a local executable during this review; no extraction was rerun.

summary.visual_correspondence_of_question_specif: No obvious wrong-question assignment was seen in the reviewed QX question-specific figures and single-question image assets.
summary.recommended_handling: Keep full-page facsimiles as document/page references rather than question_assets. For question display, retain only question-specific figure/image assets; do not delete source page images.
